name: flow-map
description: A pane beside the chat with the flows and units your skills offer; click one to put it in the prompt.

sources.title: Skill folders
sources.description: Comma-separated folders to scan for SKILL.md (up to three levels deep). ~ is your home.

units.title: Units to list
units.description: in-flows: only skills a flow chains; all: every skill that is not a flow; none: flows only.

show.title: Show only
show.description: Comma-separated skill names. When set, everything else is hidden.

hide.title: Hide
hide.description: Comma-separated skill names to leave out.

order.title: Order
order.description: Comma-separated names that come first, in this order; the rest follow alphabetically.

groups.title: Unit groups
groups.description: Group the units: 'Backlog: snapshot-backlog, prune-backlog; Workers: delegate, watch'. Ungrouped units go under Units.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts (it docks only on wide terminals). Otherwise use /flow-map.
